summary: Kevin Hern has twice publicly declared Israel's war against Gaza a righteous cause deserving his 'full support,' calling for Israel to 'destroy Hamas' and stating there is 'no defense for the behavior of the Palestinian people.' In May 2024 he voted yea on H.R. 6090, directing use of the IHRA definition in federal education-discrimination enforcement. Together these actions and statements position him as a full defender of Israel's military campaign without qualification.
